people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: I will reach out my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders which I will do among them, and after that he will let you go.
translations.bsb: So I will stretch out My hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders I will perform among them. And after that, he will release you.
translations.kjv: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
translations.asv: And I will put forth my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
